result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with multi-family brick housing and a continuous sidewalk on the left side. While the environment is low-speed in nature, it lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the visible intersection.

result.summary: This residential street lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic calming measures. While sidewalks are present, they are narrow and partially obstructed by parked vehicles and debris, forcing pedestrians into a wide, unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, increasing the risk for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars and trash bags are encroaching on or blocking the narrow pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the residential frontage

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lanes and discourage speeding.

result.summary: This residential intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but suffers from poor maintenance and visibility. Faded crosswalk markings and parked vehicles near the corner create sightline challenges for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.description: Cracking and uneven road surfaces at the crossing point increase the risk of trips or falls.
